Self-destructing shares — set a download limit.

## Added

- **Download limit / burn-after-download.** When you upload, you can now cap how
  many times a share may be downloaded (a switch in the share options; default
  1). Once the limit is reached, the file and its metadata are deleted
  immediately. The download page shows how many downloads are left.

## Notes

- The count is registered **atomically**, so concurrent downloads of a limited
  share can never exceed the limit. An encrypted share only counts a download
  once its key has been verified, so a bogus request can't burn through the
  allowance. Unlimited shares (no limit set) behave exactly as before.
